Pocket DNS browser installer embeds esptool-js 0.7.0 (Apache-2.0), CryptoJS 4.2.0 (MIT), qrcode-generator 1.4.4 (MIT), pako 2.1.0 (MIT/Zlib) and atob-lite 2.0.0 (MIT). CryptoJS is used only for MD5 flash integrity checks. Update authenticity uses ECDSA/SHA-256 in the firmware, not MD5. Firmware uses ArduinoJson 6.21.5 (MIT), Arduino ESP32 2.0.17 and Espressif SDK components under their respective upstream licences. See PlatformIO packages and official upstream distributions for complete SDK notices. Blocklist licences are separate; source snapshots accompany this release.
